coverage_issues: Report 1: API HTTP 404 errors prevented review of PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO files

learnings: Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool error' and 'inconclusive due to security uncertainty' - API failures should trigger automatic retry rather than marking files as inconclusive
Implement retry logic for transient API errors (HTTP 404, 500, timeouts) before marking a file review as failed
Advisory reports that fail to parse should not contribute to disagreement calculations
When one report successfully completes full coverage and finds no issues, while others fail due to tool errors, the successful report should carry the verdict
